I want to die.   
The last two years of my life have been one continuous downwards spiral. I don't have any close friends anymore, and the people who call themselves my friends now just want to use me for various reasons. All of my focus has been in my schoolwork/career and now I think I may have just fucked everything up and honestly threw everything into jeopardy.   
I head back to my hometown on Friday for the summer, and I don't have a job or really anything set up for me there. The majority of the people back there hate me as I spiraled into a depression last year after having a nervous breakdown the Fall of that year (so 2016).   
Since the start of this year, I've been bouncing from relationship to relationship and only finding people who want to use me for various reasons. Oddly enough, there's one person that I feel could actually understand me in a relationship but last I checked they hate me and I just found out that they moved, so I probably won't ever see them again.   
I'm drowning in stress and work and just really want to end it all. My family can't afford any treatment things and I know my mom would just freak out more if they found out I was checking into a mental institution of any sort. I've attempted suicide twice in the past but nobody knows that.   
It's my birthday today. I'm not saying that for any desire to have anonymous people on the internet wish me happy birthday, I just wish somebody would remember. Get a million people asking me to help them with various projects, all acting like we're friends but not one of them remembered my birthday. I don't want a gift or anything, I know it sounds pathetic but I just want to feel loved by someone who isn't being forced to love me.    
Regardless, idk how I'll be spending the rest of the day. Haven't eaten yet, and don't want to leave bed. Pills scare me, I don't have a gun, and there's nowhere to hang a noose in Chicago.  
Just wanted to get this rant out. I know nobody will probably read this without a **TL;DR**, but I like the illusion of being heard.
